body_lead: Thiruvananthapuram: As part of modernisation plans, the Kerala Police plans to transform the existing police stations into smart police stations. These stations prioritise digital systems for managing everything from receiving complaints to resolving it. As part of the initiative, new technologies and electronic equipment will be integrated into these stations. Twenty stations, each representing a police district, are being upgraded into smart status. Police officers with technical expertise will be stationed at these stations.
